主要内容: On February 18, 2016, SAP SE announced that Stefan Ries and Steve Singh will join the Executive Board of SAP SE as of April 1, 2016. This information was included in a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. The document is a Form 6-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), indicating that SAP SE is a foreign private issuer. The filing includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. SAP SE is a German-based company with its principal executive offices in Walldorf, Germany. The press release is incorporated by reference into the filing. The document also includes the signatures of Christoph Huetten and Christopher Sessar, who are responsible for the report.
